items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then they had Mrs. Lodoux and Mrs. C.J. Sam's and all.

ctx.x: And then they had Mrs. Lodoux and Mrs. C.J. Sam's and all. And they speak. Well, that day, that day, that day was just like conversion, it was as if it was French. They had an old lady they called Madame Gérard. She was French. And Charles Gaiary.
Oh, yes. He's a famous man, a historian.
